messages:
maya: Morning async — quick standup. Yesterday: updated the Node quickstart to use ESM import, fixed sampleapp startup ordering, and pushed docs screenshots. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Blocker: macOS wheel build keeps failing on M1 in CI (failing during wheel signing step). Need someone who can tweak cibuildwheel or the build matrix. Today: land the quickstart PR, cut a sampleapp beta, and re-run CI after the fix.

sam: saw the CI failures earlier, repro locally on mac-mini. Error is `ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture arm64` in the binary wheel step. Suspect a manylinux tag mismatch + linker flags. I'll take a look after my standup. :eyes:

anya: I can finish the screenshot alt text and start translations once the PR is merged. Heads up — the onboarding flow wording needs one small copy tweak (see inline comment on the PR).

miguel: I can own the CI fix if someone can grant me the infra token for the mac runners (we need to ssh into the mac to inspect the environment). @leo can you grant or point me to the runbook?

leo: granted to miguel — added you to `infra-build-admins`. Runbook for mac debugging is here: https://internal.redwood/ops/mac-ci-debug. Also posted the token steps in #eng-infra. :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks @leo @miguel — once you have the fix, can you post the minimal `cibuildwheel` patch? I can then update the docs quickstart to mention supported wheels/arch.

sam: quick note — while we're touching the quickstart, can we add this install command for devs on M1: `pip install redwood-sdk==0.3.2 --no-binary :all:`. It forces source build which worked for me as a temp workaround. I'll add a short note to the PR.

miguel: starting a branch now with updated `cibuildwheel` config (trying `CIBW_ARCHS_MACOS=arm64 x86_64` and setting `MACOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11.0`). If that doesn't land, I'll try bundling `LDFLAGS='-L/opt/homebrew/lib'`. Will open PR with logs.

docs-bot: Automatic note — previously reported flakey mac wheel failures tagged in CI: #ci-flaky-2026. Adding comment to PR 482 for visibility.

anya: small docs nit while I was in the repo — the quickstart code block should use `npm init @redwood/sampleapp` not `npx` (we standardized on the init flow). I'll push that tiny change to the branch.

maya: perfect — plan: miguel lands CI fix PR, sam and anya update the quickstart & notes, I will re-run the sampleapp smoke tests and then merge docs PR. If everything green I'll cut the beta and post release notes. :rocket:

sam: LGTMs — if anyone's free later, can you glance at my tiny header copy change? It's in the quickstart PR comments.

leo: glanced and left one inline about H2 heading scope. :thumbsup:

miguel: PR up with initial cibuildwheel tweaks and a short log excerpt. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/129. If CI still fails I added a diagnostic workflow you can run locally: `./scripts/mac-ci-debug.sh`.

maya: awesome. I'll wait for that and then kick off the re-run. Thanks everyone — will post final status here after merge.

sam: thanks — ping me if you want me to run the smoke locally on my M1.

maya: will do. Closing the loop for now — follow-ups in the PRs. :handshake:
